1_requirements.notes: Interview held 2026-09-09. Intake doc: northwind-commerce-discovery.md. 6 sources, Databricks lakehouse target. 5 open questions, 2 resolved same day via /finalize-requirements (GA4 via extract job; gold_pii same catalog).

2_architecture.notes: Design produced 2026-09-09. ELT on Databricks (bronze/silver/gold Delta), dbt Core + dbt-databricks, Terraform (databricks/aws/google providers), Dagster orchestration, GitHub Actions CI/CD with plan/apply + dbt build + manual promotion. Hard reconciliation gate as a Dagster asset check. 3 open design decisions carried into build.

3_build_and_test.notes: Build plan (9 components, lowest-dependency-first) + one buildsheet per component + dbt-project-scaffold + fixtures-catalog + local-dev guide. Scaffolded build/repo/ (152 files): Python 3.12 extractors for the 6 sources + common/ (config, state, secrets, landing, manifest, base, http, dbt_runner); recon/ publish/ lineage/ obs/; the dbt project (39 model stubs across staging/intermediate/marts + 4 snapshots + 5 seeds + 5 macros + 5 tests) with a DuckDB ci target; 14 skipped unit-test stubs; tiny synthetic fixtures; Makefile + pyproject + pre-commit. Stubs + TODO bodies only - Python compiles, dbt/config YAML parses. 4 open items (O1-O4); O2/O3 tied to Q3/Q4.

4_pipeline_and_git.notes: Next: /assemble-pipeline - Dagster asset graph, Terraform modules per env, GitHub Actions, wire make test into CI.
